author: YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME
name: LinkFixer
short: Replaces social media links with embed-friendly ones. Twitter/X: video-only and auto-translation.
description: Replies to messages containing links from Twitter/X, Instagram, Reddit, Pixiv, Threads, TikTok and Bilibili with versions that embed properly in Discord. Twitter/X links can be limited to tweets that contain a video or GIF, tweets written in another language are fixed with vxtwitter and /en so Discord shows an English translation, and the original message can optionally be deleted after the fixed link is posted.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data about users. It only stores per-server settings. When a message contains a Twitter/X link, the account name and tweet ID from that link are sent to api.vxtwitter.com to check whether the tweet has a video and what language it is in.
install_msg: Thanks for installing LinkFixer! Load it with `[p]load linkfixer`, turn it on with `[p]linkfixer enable`, and see `[p]help linkfixer` for the Twitter/X video-only, translation and delete-original options.
